description: This file defines the 'aclviewer' object with methods to manage role-based access control views and interactions in the SuiteCRM admin interface. It includes AJAX request functions for viewing, saving, and toggling display of ACL roles.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Initiates an AJAX request to load the ACL role view for a specific role ID and module.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Sends form data via AJAX to save ACL role changes.

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Processes the response after saving, then refreshes the view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Displays the retrieved ACL role information in the UI.

methods.name: toggleDisplay
methods.description: Allows toggling visibility of specific UI elements for ACL roles.
